meta.title: Forward auction: first bid
warnings: resolved: “Assert that the vendor portal updates and displays the live rank for a rank-strategy auction or the best price for a pri” — switch_portal / vendor_open_event open the supplier portal as the invited QA vendor in a second browser

steps.note: Open the prepared live forward auction without recreating or searching for the event.
Move to Vendor A's separate supplier-portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the live auction's pricing round from the vendor event list.
Confirm the vendor is on the bid sheet with the submission control available.
Enter the first bid price of 100 in the vendor portal and submit it.
Verify that Procol accepted the bid and the vendor portal shows the stage as Submitted.
